subject: english
prompt: The school announced a poster contest. Leo wanted to win, but he shared his best idea with Amy. Amy added a clear title, and Leo drew the picture. Their poster won first prize. Why did their poster win?

options.text: Leo refused to share his idea.
Amy did all the work alone.

answer.explanation: Leo and Amy combined their contributions, and their poster won first prize.
